title: Why it helps to charge your phone outside the bedroom
dek: Moving the charger out of the bedroom is a small change that can make weeknight sleep a little easier to protect.
body: It is ten o'clock on a Monday, and many of us know what happens when the phone comes to bed too. You plan to check one thing, and then it is eleven thirty and you have read about a dozen things you will not remember tomorrow.

Moving the charger to another room, like the kitchen counter, is a simple way to break that loop. The first few nights can feel strange. You may reach for the nightstand out of habit and find nothing there. For a lot of people, that reaching fades after a while.
If your phone is also your alarm, a basic alarm clock can take over that one job. It does not send notifications or show you the news. It just tells you the time and wakes you up.

Phones are not the enemy. They connect us to people we love and help with a hundred small tasks. I think the last hour of the day deserves some protection, though, and that is hard when the phone is within arm's reach. If poor sleep keeps happening even after changes like this, it is worth talking with a doctor.
If you want to try it, plug your phone in somewhere outside your bedroom tonight. Give it one week before you decide whether it helps.
